title: Dnipro Opera and Ballet Theatre
geometryBasis: Native multipolygon footprint and mapped building parts, operator identity record, original author-dedicated exterior Qualla photo's archived parent and the original Mapzen elevations.
sectionBasis: A deep horizontal pale rim frames a glazed two-storey frontage with strong dark vertical mullions. The recessed dark entry sits under this volume, with a taller backstage block and lower ancillary wings.
limitations: The exterior depicts the standing building. The fountain sculpture, plaza fixtures and theatre interiors are outside scope.
Mapped level differences establish the taller stage volume. Exterior heights, upper facade detail and the service-wing window spacing are estimated.
